main_issue: Whether and how Agent D can sing at 4:45 a.m. every morning for four weeks despite the other three needing sleep on specific weekdays; options of dropping the bell, silence, relocation, or earplugs.

A-B.evidence: B echoes A's worry about quiet voice (T10) and supports A's silent-Monday idea (T16); both doubt earplugs (T23, T24).

A-C.evidence: C agrees quiet voice would wake them (T11), but C is willing to try earplugs (T21) while A is unsure (T23).

A-D.evidence: A asked for Monday exception, void deck, silence (T3,13,15); D refused (T14,T17); A moved to accept the no-bell compromise partly, but still doubts earplugs (T23, T26).

B-C.evidence: B and C both say a low voice will wake them (T10, T11), but C will try earplugs (T21) while B says they won't suffice (T24).

B-D.evidence: B asks for silence Thursday (T16), D says singing is the observance (T17); B says still a problem (T18) and worries earplugs not enough (T24), D re-offers no bell (T26).

C-D.evidence: C proposes earplugs (T19) and is willing to try (T21); D asks if it would work and offers sing-only with earplugs (T20, T26).
